component.name: GodSVG
component.summary: A vector graphics application for structured SVG editing

description.p: This is a community package of GodSVG, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified. GodSVG is in late alpha.

GodSVG is a structured SVG editor. It represents the SVG code directly and lets you edit it in real time, without adding any metadata to it. GodSVG aims to be a structured SVG editor with low abstraction, producing clean, precise, optimized files.

SVG is a common vector graphics format, which allows for renderings at unlimited resolution. Unlike raster graphics, which are bound to pixels, SVGs are defined by geometric operations that are agnostic to resolution.

Despite being focused on representing the actual code structure of SVGs, GodSVG has a solid user interface derived from this structure, making it helpful for learning how the SVG format works under the hood.

Opening and saving go through the system file dialog, which gives GodSVG access to the files you pick. Dropping a file onto the window needs read access to where that file lives, which is not granted by default. To allow it for your home folder, for example:
GodSVG's built-in file dialog (Settings, "Use native file dialog" off) likewise only sees the folders granted this way.
